what: Five works (count) follow the cursor in a line — the first moves .25 of the remaining distance to the cursor each frame, the others move .2 of the way to the work ahead, tilting by the gap from the one ahead (×.15°). After the cursor first moves, each work appears scaling 0→1 with a delay of index × 120ms over .5s cubic out (silhouette, size 66u·u = window width/1400). On press, the front artwork flies to the empty spot above the shelf (the shelf’s bottom line) in .75s cubic out along a parabola 90u high while spinning, and after it stops it bounces once by 6u over .45s. The moment it lands, the shelf wobbles in place — a bell shape 110u wide × 5u × e^(−t/.32) × cos(17t), 1.3s. The landed artwork changes to its own look and sways with the shelf, and a new artwork is attached at the end of the row so five are kept. The wheel spins artworks sideways at a different speed per shelf (1, −.8, .6), following by .045 of the remainder and wrapping every 1360u, and they fade like a cylinder toward the panel edges. Flow words and shelf words (word) step aside sideways when they sit at the same height as an artwork (max 120u, .18 of the remainder each time)

options.fly: Time to fly to the shelf (sec), default .75
options.push: Max distance (u) words step aside, default 120
options.speeds: Speed per shelf when turning by wheel (comma-separated), default 1,-.8,.6

note: The item’s children are hidden and the graphic inside is cloned for use (img as a brightness(0) silhouette, svg in currentColor as --kf-ink). The layer that draws the lines does not block Interaction, so links and buttons behind it can still be pressed. Pieces are placed avoiding the shelf’s word slots and the space beside works already seated (size+14u). If no spot is found within 80 tries, the piece simply drops (gravity .55). It fires fx:land when seated and fx:drop when pressed (for adding sound). On devices without a pointer or with reduced motion, no lines are set up and one work is seated on each shelf. The wheel is intercepted only after a work has landed on a shelf, and the panel suits a one-screen page with no scroll.
